svg.title: Text lines in the repository by area at the end of each day, and the validation ledger's size, with the lines ever deleted from it: 993 of 24,523, 981 of them in the newest entry.
svg.text: What the repository is made of, and the record it keeps
Top: the text lines of every tracked file, by area, at the end of each day on main's own line. Two slices are kept
apart: the hard-workload pack, written by another model and kept as delivered, and the Arduino library's vendored
copy of host/, which counts that code a second time. Bottom: the ledger, and what was ever taken out of it.
The ledger, docs/VALIDATION.md: lines, by day
Where the lines taken out of it were
24,523 lines were added to the ledger over its life; 993 were
later deleted (4.0%). Distance from the newest entry, in
entries, when the line was deleted:
The ledger's own rule is that an entry never edits history.
981 of the 993 lines taken out were in the newest entry when
they went; 12 were in older ones. These are positions in the
file, not whether the text had been pushed. 189 commits took
lines out, and the subjects of 118 of them say restated,
corrected, fixed or a verifier's finding.
source: docs/figures/ledger.json (extract; ledger, first 2,772,018 bytes); docs/figures/tree.json (extract; 15f96c8)
